theorem_title: The left machine mask hash is the semantic endpoint
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BlockIndex.maskHash_left {h J : ℕ} (o : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BlockEncoding.Occurrences h J)
    (S : Finset (_root_.ThreeSum.BlockRows.Coord J (464*h))) :
    (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BlockIndex.maskHash o false S : ℤ) = _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BlockEncoding.endpointLeft o S := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For local dimensions $h,J$, occurrence family $o$, and coordinate subset $S$, $$\operatorname{maskHash}(o,\mathrm{false},S)=\operatorname{endpointLeft}(o,S)$$ after casting the natural hash to an integer.

This identity links the left hash computed from machine mask coordinates to the semantic left source endpoint.
